title: Zesty Flaky Syrian Pasta Bake
description: A malty, flaky, weeknight Syrian dish featuring vanilla pod and ferment-jang, ovo-vegetarian-friendly, perfect for a quick dinner

ingredients.name: pasta
ingredients.notes: preferably Syrian or middle eastern style

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat
Add the ferment-jang and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Add the spinach and cook until wilted
In a large bowl, whisk the eggs and season with salt and black pepper
Add the cooked pasta, feta cheese, and vanilla pod to the bowl and mix well
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving
